generic_sampling_rules.integer_numeric: Sample integers uniformly from the observed min..max of the column, widened by one step on each side; include the boundary literals listed in per_column_exceptions; never NULL for NOT NULL/PK columns.
generic_sampling_rules.short_text_enum: Sample from the explicit enum pool of the column; include case variants (upper/lower) of each literal when the column appears in a comparison_boundary pattern; never NULL for NOT NULL/PK columns.
generic_sampling_rules.free_text: Sample from the observed distinct values plus near-variants (case changes, one-character edits) so that DISTINCT counts stay in the 20-50% duplicate-share band; allow NULL only if the column is nullable.
generic_sampling_rules.nullable_columns: For every nullable column, each instance contains at least one NULL row and non-NULL rows; NULL share follows the compact database share (0% observed, so use a small 5-10% share to exercise IS NULL / IS NOT NULL / COUNT(col) / COALESCE); planted NULLs are never replaced.
generic_sampling_rules.primary_keys: Generate fresh unique tuples per instance; never NULL; never reuse an original value.
generic_sampling_rules.foreign_keys: Copy the parent key value from an already-generated parent row; child rows may reference only existing parents; parent rows without children are allowed; nullable FK columns may also take NULL.
generic_sampling_rules.distinct_columns: Ensure the duplicate share on DISTINCT-targeted columns stays in 20-50% by repeating a subset of values.
generic_sampling_rules.order_tie_columns: When a column is an ORDER target with a tie at a rank, plant at least two rows sharing the tie value at that rank in both ASC and DESC directions.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_numeric: For each numeric literal L in a comparison_boundary target, include L-1, L, L+1 (by the column step) in the sampled pool.
generic_sampling_rules.boundary_text: For each equality literal L in a comparison_boundary target, include L and its case variants (L upper, L lower) in the sampled pool.
generic_sampling_rules.like_near_variant: For each LIKE literal 'X%', include values starting with X and near-variants (X lower, X with one extra char) in the sampled pool.
